items.description: Leak detection and opening of the bathroom wall
items.rationale: Covered under Part 2.1: locating the leak and opening the wall to reach it. No exclusion applies. Reference Case 7 (thermal imaging and opening for leak detection) supports a fair market rate for such work.

items.description: Replacement of split copper supply pipe section, 15 mm, incl. fittings
items.rationale: Covered under Part 2.2: repairing the fractured pipe. No exclusion applies. Reference Case 7 (internal frost-burst fitting repair) supports a fair market rate for pipe repair.

items.description: Closing the wall opening, re-plastering and re-tiling approx. 0.2 m2
items.rationale: Covered under Part 2.3: restoring the damaged plaster and tiles to their previous condition. No exclusion applies. Reference Case 7 (restoration of plaster excluded for external facade, but here it is internal and directly related to the leak).

items.description: Annual service and descaling of the gas boiler in the hallway
items.rationale: Explicitly excluded by Part 3.1: maintenance, servicing or descaling of installations, even if carried out during the same visit. Not related to the insured peril.
